description: Request a FREE commercial quote for a capability execution. AOI dynamically evaluates the price based on the requested service. Returns quote_id, final USD price, currency, and validity (15 min). No execution happens and NO credits are consumed — review the price first, then call execute_quote. Requires an API key (X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer <key>).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Same key + same request returns the same quote.

name: request_quote
